item.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
item.description: Modern AI systems are increasingly being evaluated for their ability to reason, code, prove theorems, use tools, and long-horizon research tasks. These are powerful capabilities, but they share a structural limitation: the representational frame within which the model operates,...
